modes.label: Digits in statistics and dates
modes.description: A leading digit just before a decimal or later digits in a hazard ratio, year or cell number.

modes.label: Codes and identifiers
modes.description: A character inside a catalog number, article number, URL parameter or hyphenated code.

card.plain: It fires on a single digit or dash inside a code, reference number or statistic, where the number is still being written out.
